{{Top}}
[[File:ViperProbeSelfDestruct-TESB.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Viper probe droid triggers its self-destruct mechanism]]
{{Quote|Two ion-cannon blasts shorted every system I had in the ship, including the self-destruct.|[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]|<ref name="X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>}}
A '''self-destruct mechanism''' was a defense system that allowed an important craft or device to self-destruct under certain circumstances such as the threat of being captured. This was often used as a last-resort defense to protect data from being used by the enemy.

==History==
{{Quote|I didn't hit it that hard. Must've had a self-destruct.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], referring to a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid|Infiltrator demolition droid]]s are both the [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid|demolition droids]] and have the explosion charges which means there are [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]]ers of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] set themselves to self-destruct to [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|blow up]] the [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|central power distribution grid]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] goes the [[Coruscant mandatory blackout/Legends|mandatory blackout]], even to stop the vote for the [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|bill]] to de-regulate banking conglomerates.

When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] destroyed a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], the droid managed to send relay images of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] before self-destruction.

When [[Rookie One]] and [[Ru Murleen]] destroyed the [[Imdaar Alpha research station|TIE Phantom factory]] at [[Imdaar Alpha]] they brought the very last [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE Phantom]] to a Rebel base but the designers had anticipated such a possibility and each fighter was given a self-destruct mechanism disabled by some Imperial code, so that should one fall in the hands of the Rebels, they wouldn't be able to replicate its technology. After the destruction of this short-lived fighter, its technology was lost forever.

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] equipped [[TIE ap-1|TIE Maulers]] with a self-destruct mechanism as a means to do additional damage to enemy troops if the TIE Mauler was attacked. The power core of the TIE Mauler would overload and the craft would explode, destroying or damaging troops, vehicles, or structures nearby.

The [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] were also known to have their [[Vengeance-class frigate|''Vengeance''-class frigates]] and [[Aggressor-class destroyer|''Aggressor''-class Star Destroyers]] self-destruct by overheating their ship cores should the situation call for it in battle.

Before the New Republic liberated [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Tycho Celchu volunteered to fly a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] to spy on the planet, his starfighter was modified heavily with sensor packages for his mission. He was caught by the Imperials after being hit by two ion-cannon blasts, which disabled the self-destruct system.

As late as [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]] was equipped with a powerful self-destruct system.
